attributes.message: We are investigating reports of contact imports remaining in the processing state and not completing for some users. This affects imports through Contacts → Bulk Actions. We’ll share updates as more information becomes available.
Issue is resolved now and contact imports are working fine.

We are investigating an issue affecting Voice AI agents, which are currently unable to answer live calls.
The issue began around 8:45 AM UTC following a feature deployment. The initial investigation identified a missing import that disrupted the connection to a third-party provider.
Our team is working on a fix. 
We will provide further updates as progress is made.
The issue has been resolved, and Voice AI agents are now able to answer live calls as expected. The service has been restored to normal operation.

attributes.title: Voice AI – Agents Unable to Answer Calls

attributes.message: The issue has been fully resolved, and all affected services and functionalities, including AI Studio, Workflows and Automations, Generations Billing, WhatsApp, and Marketplace, are now operational and functioning as expected.

We are experiencing a platform-wide outage , this is impacting all usage-based products, including Wallet, Voice billing, Conversational AI, billing, domain purchases, AI Studio/AI Agents, and Workflow executions. Our team is working with to restore the affected data, and recovery is currently in progress. We will share further updates as more information becomes available.

The issue has been largely resolved, with the following services and functionalities restored:
AI Studio: Confirmed working as expected.
Workflows and Automations: Restored and operational.
Generations Billing: Billing for generations is working as expected.
WhatsApp: Fully restored and operational.
Marketplace: Recovery is still in progress, and the service remains unavailable.
We are continuing to work on restoring the Marketplace service fully.

We are currently investigating an issue affecting workflow triggers related to appointment creation and status changes. 
Our engineering team is actively working to restore normal processing and validate the fix. We will provide another update as soon as we have more information.
The issue has been resolved. The team restored the processing of appointment-related events and validated that workflow triggers are firing as expected.

Impact on Contacts:
From the Contacts side, we generate custom events for Contact Merge. We’re currently exploring how to recover the impacted data and safely retrigger these events from our end.

On the consumption side, from contacts-update-events, we only consume appointment-related events (Created/Updated/Deleted) for CDP activity logs and ES indexing. Both flows are idempotent/safe and can handle these events being retriggered.

Impact on SmartList:
Since the Workflow and calendar appointment and attendee events were missed, this would return incorrect result for customers in the SmartList. Replay of these events would fix these as the workers are idempotent.

There were other services impacted as well during the timelines mentioned above.
Issue stands resolved now and all the services are working as expected.
This issue is resolved now and services are working fine.

We are investigating an issue affecting WhatsApp Coexistence where echo messages are failing to sync for some contacts without WhatsApp usernames. Our team is working to resolve the issue and will share updates as more information becomes available.

attributes.title: WhatsApp Coexistence echo message sync failing

attributes.message: Opportunity actions have been restored, and the issue is now resolved. The fix has been deployed to production, and the affected functionality is working normally.

attributes.message:
We are running down issues in data sync across contacts and smartlists.
Our team is actively working to identify the root cause and restore normal synchronization as quickly as possible. We will provide another update as soon as more information is available.

The issue affecting data synchronization across Contacts and Smartlists has been resolved. Our team identified the root cause and restored normal synchronization.
All delayed updates have been processed, and no data was lost during the incident.

We identified an issue that affected appointment data visibility across certain views and reports between 12:30 PM and 2:30 PM IST. The issue has been resolved, and we are actively backfilling the affected data. We'll continue to provide updates as progress continues.

The issue has been resolved, and affected services are now operating normally.
Team has implemented a fix and verified that service has been restored. We will continue to monitor the system to ensure ongoing stability.

We’re investigating an issue affecting calendar, opportunities, contacts  and several related features. Our team is actively investigating the issue and working to restore normal functionality. We’ll provide another update as soon as we have more information.
Contacts and Opportunities are now working as expected. We are continuing to monitor the system. We’ll provide another update as soon as we have further information.

The issue affecting Opportunities, Contacts, Calendar, and Conversations has been resolved. All affected modules are now functioning normally. We have confirmed that the system is operating as expected and will continue to monitor for any further issues.
